title: Lifting a valuation ring through a flat morphism of algebraic spaces

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S and a morphism Spec(A) -> Y from a valuation ring whose closed point lies in the image of |X| -> |Y|, there is an extension of valuation rings A -> A' and a commutative diagram Spec(A') -> X over Spec(A) -> Y (source lines 8957-8974). The proof base changes to Spec(A), choosing a point of X_A over the closed point by the description of points of fibre products, then works with a surjective etale U -> X and a point u over the closed point: the local ring map A -> O_{U,u} is flat, the going-down lemma provides a prime q lying over (0), and the dominating valuation ring lemma produces A' inside kappa(q), which yields the required morphism through U.
